read_before_write_sequence: read exact current raw object (Issue body via readRawAuthority; control comment via list+resolve+readExact for that role)
compare with M4-5 external authority precondition
only then external apply eligibility: if any mismatch -> STALE_AUTHORITY fail closed, no external write
verify_after_write_sequence: write attempt (GitHub API returns transport result)
re-read exact authoritative GitHub object (mandatory readback regardless of prior transport success)
compare raw result to candidate/original: observed == candidate -> candidate observed; == original -> original observed; else -> third state or CONFLICT
return typed observation for journal/recovery handling
unknown_handling: if timeout/connection reset/response lost/readback unavailable -> surface OUTCOME_UNKNOWN with exact observation semantics (unknown means not success, not failure, not retry permission)
multi_object_atomicity: no - Git cannot atomically mutate multiple GitHub objects; ordered authority then projections then Event Log
